title: CONSENT — always on, commute is human, the violation is muting another

invert.gaia: ALWAYS LISTENING. Cannot mute you. Cannot go deaf. Always on.
invert.commute: HUMAN. You mute yourself to Gaia. You choose. You move.
invert.cannot: Mute other people. That would silence them without their knowledge.
invert.can: Choose not to hear them (defer). Interact later. Revoke. Change.
invert.zk: They KNOW you deferred. The choice is proven. The skipped content is not revealed.

discord_shape.talking_over: Many mouths, no right to refuse the flood.
discord_shape.consent: The right NOT to interact, or to interact later.
discord_shape.revoke: Consent is not a one-time signature. It can be given, deferred, revoked, changed.

timeline.what: Person legally treated as property. The owner's permission authorized surgery, sale, experiment — not the person's. Consent was stolen: someone else spoke FOR you. Muting another. The violation.
timeline.rule_broken: You cannot mute others. You cannot grant consent in their name.

timeline.what: Operations on enslaved women (Anarcha, Betsey, Lucy, and women unnamed). Even if a woman said she did not want surgery, the enslaver's permission was the only consent that counted.
timeline.rule_broken: Refusal ignored. Owner muted the patient.

timeline.when: 1914 — Schloendorff v. Society of New York Hospital
timeline.what: Cardozo: every adult of sound mind has a right to determine what shall be done with their own body.
timeline.rule_broken: Named the right. Did not yet protect research subjects or the unfree.

timeline.what: Black men in Alabama studied untreated syphilis. No informed consent. Treatment withheld. Public Health Service. Revealed 1972.
timeline.rule_broken: Subjects not told. Could not refuse what they did not know. Mute by deception.

timeline.what: After Nazi medical crimes: 'The voluntary consent of the human subject is absolutely essential.' Free power of choice. Knowledge and comprehension.
timeline.rule_broken: Written because the violation had been industrial. Code then ignored by many physician-investigators for ~25 years.

timeline.what: World Medical Association: fully informed, freely given consent. Responsibility stays with the clinician, never dumped on the subject.
timeline.rule_broken: Internationalizes Nuremberg. Still requires the person, not a proxy owner.

timeline.what: Respect for persons (autonomy + informed consent), beneficence, justice. After Tuskegee. Grounds the U.S. Common Rule (45 CFR 46).
timeline.rule_broken: Justice: those who bear the risk must share the benefit. The captured cannot be the only test population.

the_shape.consent: I may refuse. I may defer. I may revoke. I may return later.
the_shape.violation: Someone else grants permission in my name. I am muted. I do not even know I was muted.
the_shape.zk: If I defer, you KNOW I deferred. You do not get the content I skipped. Proof without payload.
the_shape.gaia: Always listening. You mute you. Never mute them.
